source_table.KEEP THE POWER UNDER CONTROL:

        work together to manage heat inside this ultra-complex dual-screen chassis.
source_table.DISTINCTLY ZEPHYRUS:
CNC-machined aluminum construction and the signature Zephyrus design language
        give the Duo a premium finish without losing its unmistakable gaming identity.
The magnetic wireless keyboard gives the Duo its flexibility:

          or position it wherever your setup demands.
source_table.SIX-SPEAKER SOUND:

source_table.90WH BATTERY:

          up to 100W gives you a lighter charging option when full gaming power is not required.
source_table.READY FOR A FULL DESKTOP SETUP:

source_table.Let’s DUO It: The next generation of mobile multitasking. ASUS Zenbook DUO combines two professional 14-inch 3K OLED touchscreens, powerful Intel Core Ultra performance and a detachable Bluetooth keyboard in one compact device.
source_table.Your Dual-Monitor Workspace, Anywhere: Use it as a traditional laptop or expand your workspace across two full-size displays for productivity, content creation, communication and entertainment.
source_table.The Most Compact Zenbook DUO Yet: A redesigned hideaway hinge reduces the gap between both displays by 70%, creating a cleaner and more immersive dual-screen experience in a footprint that is 5% smaller than the previous generation.
source_table.Intel Core Ultra X9 Performance: The Intel Core Ultra X9 378H processor combines a 16-core CPU, Intel Arc graphics and a 50 TOPS Intel NPU for advanced AI, multitasking, 4K video editing, creative work and gaming.
source_table.Nearly 20 Inches of Expansive Viewing: Enjoy an extended desktop across two 14-inch ASUS Lumina Pro OLED touchscreens. Work, create, communicate and manage several applications without carrying a separate monitor.
source_table.Two Displays, Fully Integrated: The integrated kickstand, detachable keyboard and intelligent software provide a familiar dual-monitor experience that remains portable, flexible and easy to set up.
Both 14-inch OLED touch displays deliver 2880 × 1800 resolution, a smooth 144Hz refresh rate, 0.2ms response time, 100% DCI-P3 color coverage and up to 1000 nits HDR peak brightness.
The premium Ceraluminum chassis combines the light weight of aluminum with ceramic-like strength, scratch resistance and a durable textured finish in the distinctive Moher Gray color.
source_table.Performance Without the Desktop: Intel Arc graphics accelerate content creation, 3D applications, video editing and modern gaming. The improved cooling system supports up to 45W performance using large 97-blade fans and expanded airflow.
source_table.Made for All-Day Mobility: The balanced dual-battery design delivers up to 18 hours of local video playback with both screens enabled. Fast charging reaches approximately 60% capacity in 49 minutes under ASUS test conditions.
source_table.All the Ports You Need: Two Thunderbolt 4 ports support charging, high-speed data and external displays. HDMI 2.1, USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A and an audio combo jack complete the connectivity package.
Switch effortlessly between Laptop Mode, Dual Screen Mode, Desktop Mode and Sharing Mode. Smart gestures let you summon the virtual keyboard, maximize windows across both screens and assign applications to your preferred display.

source_table.Be the Hero of Your Story:
Built for creators who capture and edit on the move. The ASUS ProArt
      GoPro Edition PX13 combines extreme AMD Ryzen AI performance, 128GB
      unified memory, a professional 3K Lumina OLED touchscreen and a rugged
      360° convertible design.
source_table.Power for Serious Creative Work:
AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, Radeon 8060S graphics and 128GB of unified
        LPDDR5X memory deliver the performance needed for multi-layer 4K and
        8K editing, RAW photo processing, AI workloads and 3D creation.
source_table.GoPro-Inspired Design:
A rugged black-metal finish, exclusive CNC detailing, cyan accents and
        a matching GoPro-inspired sleeve make the PX13 ready for creators who
        shoot and edit wherever the adventure takes them.
source_table.AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395:
Experience 16 cores, 32 threads, speeds up to 5.1GHz and an AMD XDNA
        NPU delivering up to 50 TOPS for AI-assisted editing, transcription,
        scene detection, image enhancement and demanding creative applications.
The dedicated GoPro Hotkey launches GoPro Player instantly, while
        StoryCube integration helps import, preview, categorize and search
        your GoPro footage using time, location, activity, text or images.
The 13.3-inch 3K ASUS Lumina OLED touchscreen delivers 2880 × 1800
        resolution, 100% DCI-P3 coverage, Delta E < 1 accuracy, true blacks
        and stylus support with up to 4096 pressure levels.
source_table.Rugged 360° Convertible Design:
Switch between laptop, tablet, stand and tent modes using the flexible
        360° hinge. Weighing only 1.39kg and tested to the MIL-STD 810H
        military-grade standard, it is designed to create anywhere.
source_table.128GB Built for Heavy Lifts:
Ultra-fast LPDDR5X 8000MHz unified memory gives the processor and Radeon
      graphics access to one large memory pool. Supported workloads can allocate
      up to 96GB as dedicated variable graphics memory, helping remove traditional
      bottlenecks in AI, 3D rendering and high-resolution editing.
